name: MAM-2201
summary: MAM-2201 (4'-methyl-AM-2201, 5"-fluoro-JWH-122) is a drug that presumably acts as a potent agonist for the cannabinoid receptors. It had never previously been reported in the scientific or patent literature, and was first identified by laboratories in the Netherlands and Germany in June 2011 as an ingredient in synthetic cannabis smoking blends.

pharmacology.text: A later study demonstrated that MAM-2201 bound to and activated human CB1 and CB2 cannabinoid receptors and substituted for THC in THC drug discrimination in mice.

uses.text: Like RCS-4 and AB-001, MAM-2201 thus appears to be a novel compound invented by "research chemical" suppliers specifically for grey-market recreational use. Structurally, MAM-2201 is a hybrid of two known cannabinoid compounds JWH-122 and AM-2201, both of which had previously been used as active ingredients in synthetic cannabis blends before being banned in many countries.

summaryZh: MAM-2201，化學名1-(5-氟戊基)-3-(4-甲基-1-萘甲醯基)吲哚，也稱為4'-methyl-AM-2201、5"-fluoro-JWH-122）是一種含氮有機氟化合物，化學式C25H24FNO，屬於萘甲醯基吲哚類合成大麻素，2015年列入《非藥用類麻醉藥品和精神藥品名錄》。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it specifically. Potent synthetic cannabinoids of its kind have caused a racing heart, agitation, vomiting, psychosis, seizures, kidney injury and deaths, and regular use can lead to dependence with withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它本身所知甚少。同類的強效合成大麻素曾造成心跳過快、躁動、嘔吐、精神病、癲癇發作、腎臟損傷甚至死亡，經常使用也可能導致依賴與戒斷。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它本身所知甚少。同类的强效合成大麻素曾造成心跳过快、躁动、呕吐、精神病、癫痫发作、肾脏损伤甚至死亡，经常使用也可能导致依赖与戒断。

fact.en: MAM-2201 is a hybrid of two older synthetic cannabinoids, combining the methylnaphthyl group of JWH-122 with the fluoropentyl tail of AM-2201. It was first identified in products in 2011.
fact.zh: MAM-2201 是兩種較早的合成大麻素的混合體，結合了 JWH-122 的甲基萘基與 AM-2201 的氟戊基尾端。它在2011年首次於產品中被檢出。
fact.zhHans: MAM-2201 是两种较早的合成大麻素的混合体，结合了 JWH-122 的甲基萘基与 AM-2201 的氟戊基尾端。它在2011年首次于产品中被检出。
